name: crypto/safety-number
description: Safety number (design B.1): per key h = SHA-512("pingers/v1/safety-number" || pk), then h = SHA-512(h || pk) 5199 more times; six big-endian 40-bit slices of h[..30], each modulo 10^5 as five digits; the bytewise smaller key's 30 digits first. Also the inviter fingerprint SHA-256(pk)[..8] of first_key. Expected values computed independently with openssl (not the Rust code).
